Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone UWAN
Issued at: 5:00 PM, 09 November 2025(Sunday)

RED WARNING LEVEL: Quezon(Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Patnanungan, Jomalig).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Serious FLOODING is expected in flood-prone areas.

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Rizal, Laguna, Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Catanauan, General Luna, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Unisan, Calauag, Guinayangan, Tagkawayan), Bulacan(Dona Remedios Trinidad, Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria, Angat, San Rafael, San Ildefonso, San Miguel) and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Gabaldon, Gapan, Penaranda, Palayan, Laur).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Cavite, Batangas, Tarlac, Pampanga, Bulacan(Balagtas, Baliuag, Bocaue, Bulakan, Bustos, Calumpit, Malolos, Meycauayan, Guiguinto, Hagonoy, Marilao, Obando, Pandi, Paombong, Plaridel, Pulilan) and Nueva Ecija(Cabiao, San Antonio, San Isidro, Aliaga, Bongabon, Cabanatuan, Carranglan, Cuyapo, General Mamerto Natividad, Guimba, Jaen, Licab, Llanera, Lupao, Nampicuan, Pantabangan, Quezon, Rizal, San Jose, San Leonardo, Santa Rosa, Santo Domingo, Munoz, Talavera, Talugtug, Zaragoza).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Zambales and Bataan which may persist within 3 hours.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.

For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.

Evacuation Update as of November 9, 2025 | 4:00 PM

Bilang pag-iingat sa pagbaha na sanhi ng mga pag-ulan dulot ng Bagyong #UwanPH, mayroong itinalagang evacuation sites sa mga piling lugar na bahain o may banta ng landslide para sa ligtas at mabilis na paglikas.

Sa kasalukuyan, nasa 1,213 pamilya o 4,047 indibidwal ang inilikas at namamalagi sa evacuation sites sa ating lungsod. 

Para sa emergency, tumawag sa Quezon City HELPLINE 122.
